commands.name: proc_cmdlines
commands.command: for p in 102 104 108 110 156 266 271 275 288 959; do echo PID=$p; tr '\0' ' ' < /proc/$p/cmdline; echo; done

commands.name: proc_maps
commands.command: for p in 102 104 108 110 156 266 271 275 288 959; do echo ====PID=$p; cat /proc/$p/maps; done

commands.name: rpmsg_sysfs
commands.command: for p in /sys/bus/rpmsg/devices/rpmsg*; do echo ==== $p; readlink -f $p; for f in name modalias driver/uevent power/runtime_status; do [ -e $p/$f ] && { echo --$f; cat $p/$f; }; done; done; for p in /sys/bus/platform/devices/c0_and_c1.7/remoteproc0/*; do [ -f $p ] && { echo ==== $p; cat $p; }; done
